title: SEO & Keyword Strategy: World Cup 2026 + Fantasy Football 2026
subtitle: Organic Search
description: SEO and keyword strategy targeting World Cup 2026 and Fantasy Football 2026 search demand.
body:
## SEO & Keyword Strategy Delivered

Full strategy built and published as the plan document: [OTH-26#document-plan](/OTH/issues/OTH-26#document-plan)

### What's in the plan

- **7 deliverables covered** — World Cup content plan, Best Ball keyword strategy, Pick'em props strategy, competitive gap analysis, Top 10 priority keywords, content calendar with briefs, technical SEO quick wins
- **World Cup 2026 is the critical window** — tournament is June 11, content must go live this week to have time to index; no competitor (PrizePicks, DraftKings, FanDuel) is targeting World Cup fantasy keywords
- **Confirmed competitor gap:** PrizePicks Playbook blog does not cover World Cup, Best Ball, or Battle Royale — white space across all three Underdog products
- **Urgent branded traffic leak:** FootballGuys.com and FantasyLife.com are ranking for "Underdog best ball rankings" — Underdog needs a canonical rankings page at /best-ball/rankings in May to reclaim this

### Top 3 action items (prioritized)

1. **Publish World Cup Pick'em landing page this week** (April 14–20) — highest impact, time-sensitive
2. **Reclaim branded Best Ball rankings traffic** — publish /best-ball/rankings in May before NFL draft season ramps
3. **Battle Royale pillar page** — exclusive product, near-zero keyword competition, easy category ownership

### Top 10 keywords to track

`world cup fantasy`, `world cup pick em`, `underdog best ball rankings`, `best ball fantasy football`, `soccer pick em`, `pick em fantasy sports`, `best ball fantasy app`, `battle royale fantasy`, `world cup fantasy soccer`, `fantasy football app 2026`

### Recommended immediate next step

Pull current Google Search Console data to identify which target keywords Underdog already has indexed positions 20–50 — those are the fastest optimization wins before we publish net-new content.
